payload.text: #218 (per-worker split) and #219 (record step list one jq, fork-free reads) merged. deploy.sh PR gate: 80 s PR / 77 s queue (158 s at #210); slowest part 50.4-52.5 s (60.7 at #217), parts balanced 46-52 s. Floor with two 4-vCPU jobs: ~36 s verify (250 CPU-s / 7 workers) + ~24 s fixed (setup 17 s, aggregator 7 s) = 55-60 s. Reaching <=60 s with margin needs a third batch job (max_entries_to_build 5 -> 3).
